ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated along the trailing edge and median notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous mass across both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a high-contrast border along the entire trailing edge and a vertical band at the median notch. Sparse low-intensity punctate spots (flecks) are visible in the lower-central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 45 degrees and high vertical penetration into the fluke main body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, small-amplitude serrations along the left lobe trailing edge. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits more irregular, larger-scale indentations and a distinct notch approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature on the trailing edges of both lobes as they converge toward the median notch; convex curvature on the visible portions of the leading edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-relief, circular, tan-to-white pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of three to four parallel, diagonal, tan-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are clearly visible in the upper-outer quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks on the right lobe surface; calcareous barnacle clusters present on both distal tips; irregular trailing edge notch on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct vertical black pigmentation band originating at the median notch and extending anteriorly into the fluke surface.
